## **靶场介绍**

taoCMS v3.0.2 文件管理处存在任意文件上传漏洞，攻击者可执行任意代码

##  **开启靶场**

![1684147775_64620e3f16b1be93a99cd.png!small?1684147777255](https://image.3001.net/images/20230515/1684147775_64620e3f16b1be93a99cd.png!small?1684147777255)

##  **解题步骤**

通过弱口令admin/tao ，登陆后台

![1684147766_64620e36c1843a05ed9be.png!small?1684147768649](https://image.3001.net/images/20230515/1684147766_64620e36c1843a05ed9be.png!small?1684147768649)  

在文件管理处新建框内写入 ** **test.php**** 点击新建文件

![1684147785_64620e499d054522334b9.png!small?1684147787938](https://image.3001.net/images/20230515/1684147785_64620e499d054522334b9.png!small?1684147787938)

新建后选择刚建的文件，点击编辑并写入shell

![1684147798_64620e56a6995b811e421.png!small?1684147800831](https://image.3001.net/images/20230515/1684147798_64620e56a6995b811e421.png!small?1684147800831)

![1684147809_64620e617cc5b61a6f4b7.png!small?1684147811351](https://image.3001.net/images/20230515/1684147809_64620e617cc5b61a6f4b7.png!small?1684147811351)

访问test.php获取flag

![1684147820_64620e6cbbcb5bddea646.png!small?1684147822971](https://image.3001.net/images/20230515/1684147820_64620e6cbbcb5bddea646.png!small?1684147822971)
